f06_provenance_check.assessment: The parser is not pointing both runs to the same path: each run has its own run directory, its own sfem_eue.f06 path, and its own Nastran Current Dir in the solver log. The identical SHA256 means Nastran produced byte-identical .f06 content for two different runs, not that the parser reused the same file path.

pipeline_failure_hypotheses_ranked.title: The variant modifies the BDF, but the execution chain effectively solves the same baseline bulk data because the injected CONM2 cards are outside the solved deck.
evidence_for: Variant CONM2 cards are located after ENDDATA in runs/029.../SFEM_EUE.bdf.
Both solver logs report the same 2817 JID records read and the same 2742 DOF.
The resulting .f06 SHA256 is identical even though the BDF SHA256 differs.
mass_summary.json for 029 increases mass because the manual mass parser scans the whole text file and counts post-ENDDATA CONM2 cards.
evidence_against: None of the artifact-provenance checks contradict this explanation.

pipeline_failure_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Cross-run output reuse or parser path mix-up.
evidence_for: The .f06 content is byte-identical between runs.
evidence_against: Each run has a different run_dir, different Current Dir in sfem_eue.log, and different output file paths in nastran_execution.json.
The .f04, .h5 and .log hashes differ between runs, which is inconsistent with a wholesale artifact copy/overwrite bug.
sweep_engine.py builds the comparison snapshot directly from each fresh run_payload, not from a cached baseline file.

pipeline_failure_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: The compare report is using cached modal data instead of each run result.
evidence_for: The compare JSON reports identical modal metrics.
evidence_against: sweep_engine.py: run_backplane_compare() calls run_single_case() twice and snapshots each returned run payload directly.
The compare artifact run IDs match 028 and 029 and its modal values match each run manifest payload.

physical_modeling_hypotheses_ranked.title: The chosen CONM2 support nodes are on a stiff rig/interface line and may be dynamically low-sensitivity even after the pipeline bug is fixed.
evidence_for: All three resolved nodes belong to region/group 12_RIG-V1_yp, not to an explicit backplane/interconnect region.
Each chosen node is tied through CBUSH property 20 to partner nodes 2000/3000/4000.
PBUSH 20 uses translational stiffness 1e9 in the BDF, which is effectively very stiff for a local contact surrogate.
evidence_against: This cannot explain the current identical .f06 by itself because the primary current issue is that the CONM2 cards are not inside the solved bulk data.

physical_modeling_hypotheses_ranked.title: A pure CONM2 representation is physically incomplete because real backplanes contribute not only mass but also a stiffness/load path between modules.
evidence_for: Real backplanes can alter both inertia and coupling stiffness between adjacent modules.
The current equivalent representation adds only lumped mass and no structural path.
evidence_against: The current A/B did not actually test this physical limitation yet because Nastran ignored the injected CONM2 cards.

physical_modeling_hypotheses_ranked.title: The variant is solved correctly and simply has no appreciable modal effect on the first 10 modes.
evidence_for: If a future corrected run still yields nearly identical modes, this would become plausible.
evidence_against: The current variant was not actually solved with active CONM2 mass because the cards sit after ENDDATA.

most_likely_explanation: The original 028/029 A/B was invalid because of the ENDDATA pipeline bug. After the fix, the new 030/031 A/B shows that the pipeline now works correctly and that the chosen equivalent backplane mass produces a small but real modal effect.
recommended_next_experiment: The pipeline bug is closed. The next experiment should stay on the physics side: keep the same modal parameters, but test better support_nodes on the intended backplane/interconnect path or activate a richer local equivalent representation if you want to assess whether stiffness/load-path effects matter.
recommended_code_fix: Implemented. Keep the new ENDDATA guards and consider extending the comparison artifact to include provenance hashes and JID-record counts directly so future forensic checks are immediate.
accepted_bug_diagnosis: Equivalent backplane CONM2 cards were inserted after ENDDATA when the deck ended with a suffixed line such as ENDDATA e43856d8. MSC Nastran ignored those cards, but the manual mass parser still counted them because it scanned past ENDDATA.

changes: Added ENDDATA prefix detection so insertion works for ENDDATA and ENDDATA <suffix>.
Equivalent-mass cards are now inserted immediately before the first ENDDATA-prefixed line.
If no ENDDATA exists, the injector appends at EOF and records a traceability warning.
Backplane metadata reader now stops at ENDDATA so post-ENDDATA garbage is not treated as active solver data.
Manual mass parsing now stops at ENDDATA and ignores any trailing text/cards.
This keeps mass_summary.json aligned with the actual bulk data solved by Nastran.

bdf_and_solver_validation.assessment: The fix is validated at pipeline level: the variant CONM2 cards are now physically located before ENDDATA, MSC Nastran reads more JID records for the variant deck (2817 -> 2828), and the variant .f06 SHA256 is no longer identical to the baseline.

modal_result_check.assessment: After the fix, the modal outputs are no longer byte-identical. The effect is real but small: several frequencies shift slightly, mean MAC changes by a small amount, worst MAC changes slightly, and the pairing signature remains the same. The reject reason still remains outside_frequency_gate for both runs.

mass_result_check.assessment: The variant mass is now consistently visible both in the solved BDF and in mass_summary.json. The functional imputation residual remains because equivalent backplane mass is intentionally tracked as an added unmapped residual in the current mass-budget logic.

final_assessment.conclusion: The major inconsistency was a pipeline bug. Once fixed, the same A/B experiment no longer collapses to identical .f06 output. The remaining effect at the current target locations is small, so the next discussion can move from debugging to physical representativeness.
